ffmpeg.title: FFmpeg is not installed
ffmpeg.text: Orcaton reads audio from your media files with FFmpeg — a free program that is installed separately. Install it with one click or run the command in a terminal.
ffmpeg.env: Or set ORCATON_FFMPEG_DIR to the folder with ffmpeg and ffprobe. Opening a timeline works without FFmpeg.
ffmpeg.via.winget: Installs the FFmpeg build by Gyan with winget, which is part of Windows. FFmpeg is free software (GPL); by installing you accept its license.
ffmpeg.via.linux: Installs FFmpeg with the system package manager; it asks for your password.
ffmpeg.problem.no_winget: winget is not available: install “App Installer” from Microsoft Store, then press Check again.
ffmpeg.problem.no_brew: Homebrew is not installed: install it from brew.sh, then run the command above in Terminal and press Check again.
ffmpeg.problem.no_pkexec: Run the command above in a terminal (it asks for your password), then press Check again.
ffmpeg.problem.no_manager: Install FFmpeg with your system's package manager, then press Check again.
ffmpeg.old: FFmpeg {version} is older than {min}. Orcaton should still work, but it is tested with {min} and newer — consider updating FFmpeg.
place.hint.edges: Never inside a synced block: before it or into gaps between blocks; the rest at the end.
place.hint.order_time: Each file next to its camera neighbours in recording order, also inside synced blocks. Only files missing on disk go to the end.
place.hint.end: All unmatched files at the end of the timeline.
place.hint.remove: Unmatched files are left out of the new timeline.
order.name: File number first
order.hint.name: Files of one camera follow the number in the name (MVI_0001, C0001, 00001…), then the recording time. Numbers of different cameras are never compared.
order.hint.time: Files of one camera follow the recording time (or timecode), then the name.
singles.hint.sequential: An unmatched file never plays at the same time as other files without an audio match: it moves next to its camera neighbours, adding time if needed. Synced blocks are not changed.
singles.hint.stacked: Each unmatched file stays in its camera order; files of different cameras may play at the same time.
